_meta.platform: wyoleg.gov (Angular SPA over the LSO JSON API)
_meta.status: draft - not registered in pipeline/lib/seeds.py or the daily cron
_meta.notes: Wyoming has a part-time citizen legislature (31 senators, 62 representatives). Verified live 2026-07-25: no individual legislator has an official press-release page, and the LSO OpenAPI spec exposes no member-level press endpoint. The only official press surface is the institutional LSO news-release feed, which runs 6-18 items per year. The 93 member rows carry collection_method=null so load_members() skips them by default; they exist to hold the verified roster, district, leadership and official press email.

members.notes: Institutional Legislative Service Office releases, not member-attributed. JSON API returns description/releaseDate/releaseYear/pdfFilePath per item; body lives in the linked PDF. One call per year, no pagination. Verified 2026-07-25: 8 items in 2026, 12 in 2025, 134 across 2015-2026.
